_comment: How far along one project is with one obligation.
Four answers, and the fourth is not a way of hiding one. An obligation
that binds a shipped binary need not bind an internal service, and
recording 'not applicable' says somebody looked and decided; an untouched
row says nobody looked at all. The two must not collapse into each other,
which is also why the absence of a record stays null rather than becoming
Three places read this vocabulary: the backend validator that rejects an
unknown name, the frontend control that offers the choices, and this file.
A name the control offers but the API refuses fails only on save, after
the work is done; a name the API accepts but the control omits is a state
Order is asserted: the control offers them in this order, from untouched
to finished, with the deliberate 'this does not bind us' answer last so it
does not read as a step along the way.
